definitions.explanation: A traditional form of Japanese comedy featuring two performers: a straight man (tsukkomi) and a funny man (boke) in rapid-fire dialogue.

examples.japanese: {漫才|まんざい}を{見|み}て{笑|わら}った。
{漫才|まんざい}コンビを{組|く}んでいる。
examples.english: I'm part of a manzai duo.

examples.japanese: {大阪|おおさか}は{漫才|まんざい}で{有名|ゆうめい}だ。

notes:
COMPOUND: {漫|まん} (random, comic) + {才|さい} (talent)

KEY ROLES:
・ボケ (funny man) - delivers absurd/silly lines
・{突|つ}っ{込|こ}み (straight man) - corrects and reacts to boke

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{漫才|まんざい}をする/やる (to do manzai)
・{漫才|まんざい}コンビ (manzai duo)
・{漫才|まんざい}{師|し} (manzai performer)
・M-1グランプリ (M-1 Grand Prix - famous manzai competition)

CONTRAST:
・{漫才|まんざい} - duo comedy, dialogue-based
・{落語|らくご} - solo comedic storytelling
・コント - sketch comedy
・{一人|ひとり}ボケ{突|つ}っ{込|こ}み (solo routine playing both roles)

OSAKA CONNECTION:
Manzai is strongly associated with Osaka and the Kansai region. Major talent agencies like 吉本興業 are based there.
